title: Practice 5: Numerals, nouns and adjectives together

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: How many wives does this Mormon have?
exercises.why: **сколько жён** — сколько with something you can count takes the genitive plural (жена → жён).

exercises.prompt: There were a lot of young couples in the park.
exercises.why: **много молодых** — много with something you can count takes the genitive plural (молодой → молодых).

exercises.prompt: There aren't so many gays here.
exercises.why: **много геев** — много with something you can count takes the genitive plural (гей → геев).

exercises.prompt: I run five miles a day.
exercises.why: **пять миль** — 5–20, 25–30, 35–40… take the genitive plural (миля → миль).

exercises.prompt: That trio has already put out five albums.
exercises.why: **пять альбомов** — 5–20, 25–30, 35–40… take the genitive plural (альбом → альбомов).

exercises.prompt: All mammals have seven cervical vertebrae.
exercises.why: **семь шейных позвонков** — 5–20, 25–30, 35–40… take the genitive plural (шейный позвонок → шейных позвонков).
**много канадцев** — много with something you can count takes the genitive plural (канадец → канадцев).

exercises.prompt: I read a lot of novels.
exercises.why: **много романов** — много with something you can count takes the genitive plural (роман → романов).

exercises.prompt: One meter of cloth costs two euros.
exercises.why: **два евро** — 2–4, 22–24, 32–34… (not 12–14) take the genitive singular (евро → евро).
**семь гномов** — 5–20, 25–30, 35–40… take the genitive plural (гном → гномов).

exercises.prompt: Here there are a few stuck keys.
exercises.why: **несколько клавиш** — несколько with something you can count takes the genitive plural (клавиша → клавиш).
**три секретарши** — 2–4, 22–24, 32–34… (not 12–14) take the genitive singular (секретарша → секретарши).
**семь мегабайт** — 5–20, 25–30, 35–40… take the genitive plural (мегабайт → мегабайт).
**пятьсот деталей** — round tens and hundreds (30, 50, 100, 800…) take the genitive plural (деталь → деталей).
**два пацана** — 2–4, 22–24, 32–34… (not 12–14) take the genitive singular (пацан → пацана).

exercises.prompt: Two pints are equal to a quart.
exercises.why: **две пинты** — 2–4, 22–24, 32–34… (not 12–14) take the genitive singular (пинта → пинты).

exercises.prompt: Among the guests were two foreign women.
exercises.why: **две иностранки** — 2–4, 22–24, 32–34… (not 12–14) take the genitive singular (иностранка → иностранки).

exercises.prompt: I only have two plane tickets.
exercises.why: **два авиабилета** — 2–4, 22–24, 32–34… (not 12–14) take the genitive singular (авиабилет → авиабилета).

exercises.prompt: There are too many regional differences.
exercises.why: **много региональных различий** — много with something you can count takes the genitive plural (региональный различие → региональных различий).
